certificate.method: sequential-rectified (L=1 looks, Bonferroni delta shares [1.0], bottled-count look selection)
certificate.guarantee: P[share of final answers != expert > 0.05] <= 0.1; E[#bottled answers != expert]/N <= 2.98% (exact worst case of this procedure)
certificate.scope: errors that reach the output (calibration items are answered by the expert)

risk.scope: U = #bottled answers != expert (bottled = accepted and not expert-labelled); final share <= U/N + unusable_share. Worst case over workloads, over the calibration draw; depends on (n, N, k) only
